breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained a contradiction by specifying both 'time_integration: Explicit forward Euler' and a more complex 'method: Strang splitting'. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent failed to resolve this conflict and instead repeated both contradictory instructions in the generated specification, listing 'Time integration: Explicit forward Euler' and 'Method: Strang splitting'.
